# Interaction spec

agent proposal, written by Codex 2026-11-15 at Ben's ask

## Shared defaults

This specifies the proposed iPhone behavior, not a claim that the current demo implements it. Rows plus these defaults are the build and test contract. The JSON has the same records. Source group IDs are included for audit and explicitly marked as having no target. Template braces retain the source variable, for example `tile-{it.id}`. `tab-{key}` maps index to today. `gesture:` identifiers name surfaces that have no code ID today. Conditional destinations are spelled out in Result; JSON `to` records the primary branch when its single-string schema cannot encode several branches.

Follow the standards in the order Ben named. Observed facts below come from the local code and the linked standards. All proposed behavior, timing choices within token values and failure handling are agent proposals. Apple sources were opened on 2026-11-15; the sheet guidance includes its March 24, 2026 button-placement update. Native durations remain owned by iOS rather than pretending the OS exposes a fixed millisecond value.

Defaults apply to every row unless it says otherwise:

- Press `scale`: 0.97 in 150 ms, spring duration 150/dampingRatio 1; release to 1 in 300 ms with dampingRatio 1. `highlight`: gray fill in/out 150 ms without scaling. `opacity`: 0.4 in/out 150 ms without scaling. `none`: native focus or direct manipulation. Reduce Motion replaces scale with opacity 0.7 in/out 150 ms. Release inside commits once; release outside or cancellation commits nothing; new touch interrupts from the live value. Child taps never also open the parent card.
- Motion names come from motion.ts. Custom timing uses token ease-out cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); enter 300 ms, exit 200 ms. Native default 0 ms means zero app-added motion; iOS owns its duration and curve. Constant actions add no content animation; the frontend table's press-feedback exception still applies. No move blocks interaction.
- Idle shows the current label/value/check. Pressed uses the row feedback. Disabled shows its reason and takes no action. Loading latches one operation before yielding, ignores duplicate taps, delays progress 150 ms and retains it at least 300 ms; real stages replace indefinite spinners. Done shows the acknowledged state; partial failures remain. Retry reuses the same operation and repeats only unfinished work. A 5000 ms Undo is shown only for a supported inverse or an unsent cancellation. Back never reverses an event.
- Haptics follow device settings and fire once on the named commit, never on press-in or scroll. Native feedback counts; do not double it. A new failed operation gets warning once with its brick badge, fieldsFill 150 ms or instant under Reduce Motion. A real sale alone gets sold 300 ms, dampingRatio 1, one field fill and success/sound on acknowledgment; Reduce Motion keeps haptic only.
- Minimum hit size 44 pt, expanded no more than half each neighbour gap. Footer buttons are 48 pt; pills/icons are 40 pt visible. Gutter 20, related parts 8/12, cards 16, sections 32. Preserve safe-area, keyboard and Dynamic Type access. Sheets use one native formSheet with medium/large detents, medium initially; keyboard/overflow expands to large. A destructive confirm is a native action sheet. Queues are fullScreenModal tasks with their own stack and Close.
- Every committed tap/pick/settled gesture logs user.input, then ui.show for the visible result. Mask text under text, never value. Log was/to for state.change, decision.answer for an answered decision, item.action for lifecycle steps, and call.start/end for all native/HTTP calls; failures log error. No independent log for source-only group aliases. `always` means always on its owning screen, including disabled/working states, rather than always across the whole app.

**Conflicts used in the rows.** R means Ben's requested row highlight or bar opacity overrides the brand's generic scale instruction. F means frontend-standard's explicit 150/200/300 ms moments override Appllama's under-150 ms tens-a-day and 400 ms spring examples. E means the earlier token ease-out and no-bounce rule override Appllama's stronger cubic and overshooting springs. O means frontend-standard's origin-aware item/New/camera continuity overrides Appllama's always-native screen transition rule. G means the earlier brand keeps its opaque controls, spacing and full tab bar instead of automatically taking iOS 26 Liquid Glass or minimizing the tab bar. P means a page-purpose conflict is retained from the existing route and called out as missing code, not silently invented as an implemented control. Conflicts are named in each affected row.

Sources, in precedence order: [frontend-standard section 3](../product/frontend-standard.md#3-motion), [brand Articles 7 and 11](../brand/constitution.md), [Appllama navigation and motion laws](../.agents/vendor/appllama/appllama-app-design-skill/SKILL.md), [motion patterns](../.agents/vendor/appllama/appllama-app-design-skill/references/motion.md), [native controls](../.agents/vendor/appllama/appllama-app-design-skill/references/native-controls.md), [page purposes and destinations](pages.md), [log contract](../log/README.md). Apple supports brief purposeful motion and alternatives under accessibility settings in [Motion](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion); supports medium/large sheet detents, a grabber and swipe dismissal in [Sheets](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/sheets); asks for consistent, optional, discrete haptics in [Playing haptics](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/playing-haptics). [Buttons](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons) and [Apple's iOS 26 UIKit session](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/284/) supply native behavior where earlier standards are silent.

**Code differs**

- app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:37: Undo restores local decision visibility rather than reversing a sent offer.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:47: offer send is a 600 ms timer; its deferred-send comment is not implemented.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:115: actions are local timers, not acknowledged decision/site operations.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:283: /you/automation is unregistered; row targets /you/rules.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:94: Undo restores local visibility, without an acknowledged external inverse.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:261: batch changes lack durable per-item operation IDs and acknowledged inverse results.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:14: Plan is transparentModal, not formSheet with detents.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:15: Post is transparentModal with no native detents.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/post.tsx:137: Post remains enabled-looking with no checked sites and relies on a handler return.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/post.tsx:198: Retry clears the failed marker without retrying the site request.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:149: address action commits directly; contract opens the separately approved address form.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:157: Block lacks a native destructive confirmation.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:168: relink targets unregistered /you/accounts; contract uses /you/connections/{site}.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:257: Fix the odd one is modeled as a completed act without a grouping editor.
- app/src/ui/layout.tsx:49: the shared ScrollView has no keyboard-avoidance strategy or explicit committed scroll-state log.
- app/src/ui/log.ts:17: memory-only lines have no durable upload sink; the log contract requires replayable external calls and state results.
- app/src/ui/parts/buttons.tsx:91: plain IconButton fills gray; row specifies opacity alone.
- app/src/ui/parts/cards.tsx:157: More remains active during working; contract blocks sibling decision commits.
- app/src/ui/parts/chrome.tsx:139: active-tab re-tap is not explicitly implemented as pop-to-root then scroll-to-top.
- app/src/ui/parts/chrome.tsx:177: New has no long-press handler.
- app/src/ui/parts/overlays.tsx:18: local Sheet has no detents, drag handoff or explicit unsaved-work guard.
- app/src/ui/parts/route-sheet.tsx:43: custom entry/exit has no explicit opacity Reduce Motion fallback.
- app/src/ui/parts/route-sheet.tsx:52: header pan is unlogged and rebounds with duration 400/dampingRatio 0.8 instead of the earlier no-bounce vocabulary.
- app/src/ui/parts/route-sheet.tsx:52: pan dismissal has no input log or detent semantics; rebounding uses an overshooting 400 ms spring.
- app/src/ui/press.tsx:65: every Press scales; this contract distinguishes row highlight and bar opacity.

In account Settings, refuse while a sale is open; end all listings before deleting account data and replace with /onboarding. Both are one-way doors; failures preserve undeleted data and show the failed step. One-way door after successful completion: remove the completed task or deleted entity from the stack. Back and edge swipe reach its presenter or tab root, never obsolete state. Block removal only while an irreversible request is in flight, showing its actual step. Never on press-in or scroll. | rare | Idle/pressed/done: shared defaults. Disabled: Disable when required values are invalid or missing, the entity is no longer actionable, or this operation is in flight; show the exact reason. Visible: On Item only in Delete confirmation without an open sale; in Settings only in Delete account confirmation with zero open sales. Loading: Latch one operation ID synchronously before awaiting; ignore further taps. Preserve width. After 150 ms show the named step for at least 300 ms; after 1 second show real stage/site progress. Offline: Waiting for signal, never Done. Retry reuses the operation ID. Failed: Retain this action and values. Show one brick failure badge, failed site/step and Retry; warning haptic once on arrival. Retry only unfinished work with the same operation ID. Never claim external successes rolled back. **Code differs**

- app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:37: Undo restores local decision visibility rather than reversing a sent offer.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:47: offer send is a 600 ms timer; its deferred-send comment is not implemented.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:115: actions are local timers, not acknowledged decision/site operations.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:283: /you/automation is unregistered; row targets /you/rules.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:94: Undo restores local visibility, without an acknowledged external inverse.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:261: batch changes lack durable per-item operation IDs and acknowledged inverse results.
- app/src/app/dev/parts.tsx:74: many specimen actions have no handlers; they must remain local examples and cannot be used to prove production effects.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:14: Plan is transparentModal, not formSheet with detents.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:16: Pickup inherits push instead of formSheet.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:16: Ship inherits a push, instead of the task sheet contract.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/index.tsx:237: storage location has no onChange, so edits are discarded.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/index.tsx:255: Copy shows a toast without creating a new draft.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/index.tsx:568: Delete remains a local confirmation without acknowledged deletion and root replacement.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/index.tsx:595: photo treatment and live update controls use local state, without real photo jobs or per-site acknowledgments.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/index.tsx:698: split reports a move without creating the destination item.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:106: buyer messages use a local timer, without sending acknowledgments or failed Retry.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:111: Apple Calendar uses a data URL instead of a native calendar editor.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:237: empty-address approval is enabled and silently returns.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:150: label and carrier flows do not implement the complete native print and acknowledged failure lifecycle.
- app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:111: visitor sign-in pushes onboarding instead of a resumable modal over the listing.
- app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:59: offer submission is a local timer.
- app/src/app/messages/[id].tsx:143: composer send path has no full acknowledged failed/retry lifecycle.
- app/src/app/messages/[id].tsx:173: Block commits directly without a destructive confirmation.
- app/src/app/messages/index.tsx:112: /you/messages is unregistered; row targets /you/defaults.
- app/src/app/messages/index.tsx:52: Send is a 700 ms timer without a remote operation ID.
- app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:26: authenticated state is local, without protected-route removal.
- app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:49: Back changes a local setup step but edge swipe does not share that step logic.
- app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:98: page contract steps for import review, sales email and notification permission are absent; this spec covers existing touch surfaces and does not invent their IDs.

- app/src/app/product/[id].tsx:41: follow state is local only, with no remote save or failed state.

**Code differs**

- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:115: actions are local timers, not acknowledged decision/site operations.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:283: /you/automation is unregistered; row targets /you/rules.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:94: Undo restores local visibility, without an acknowledged external inverse.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:149: address action commits directly; contract opens the separately approved address form.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:157: Block lacks a native destructive confirmation.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:168: relink targets unregistered /you/accounts; contract uses /you/connections/{site}.
- app/src/today/cards.ts:257: Fix the odd one is modeled as a completed act without a grouping editor.
- app/src/ui/parts/cards.tsx:157: More remains active during working; contract blocks sibling decision commits.
- Shared feedback differs for amount-value-input (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:237); amount-value (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:237); handled (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:218); log-all (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:283); queue-price-input (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:286); queue-price (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:286); {c.key}-more (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:197); {n.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:217). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for amount-send (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:241); queue-approve (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:286); {compare.key}-keep-first (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:265); {primary.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:197); {second.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:197). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. Affected call sites: app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:63, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:72, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:169, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:197, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:210, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:214, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:217, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:218, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:228, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:237, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:241, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:259, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:265, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:277, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:283, app/src/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:286, app/src/today/cards.ts:241, app/src/today/cards.ts:285, app/src/today/cards.ts:301, app/src/today/cards.ts:82.

**Code differs**

- app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:261: batch changes lack durable per-item operation IDs and acknowledged inverse results.
- Shared feedback differs for bulk-delete (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:258); bulk-donated (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:256); bulk-keep (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:255); bulk-sold_elsewhere (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:257); sell-pause (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:243); sort-{s.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:249). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for bulk-approve (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:261); bulk-approve (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:262); bulk-delete (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:258); bulk-donated (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:256); bulk-keep (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:255); bulk-sold_elsewhere (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:257); filter-all (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:215); filter-site-{s} (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:220); filter-sort (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:214); filter-{s.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:217); sell-pause (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:243); sort-{s.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:249). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. **Code differs**

- app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:37: Undo restores local decision visibility rather than reversing a sent offer.
- app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:47: offer send is a 600 ms timer; its deferred-send comment is not implemented.
- Shared feedback differs for buy-offer-amount-{o.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:133); buy-offer-other-input (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:133); buy-offer-other (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:133); buy-search-camera (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:87); buy-search-input (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:87); buy-search (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:87); {d.id}-more (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:63); {d.id}-more (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:72). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for buy-offer-amount-{o.id} (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:133); buy-offer-send (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:133); {d.id}-change (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:63); {d.id}-raise (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:72); {d.id}-send (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:63); {d.id}-walk (app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:72). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. Affected call sites: app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:108, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:117, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:126, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:133, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:140, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:141, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:63, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:72, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:87, app/src/app/(tabs)/buy.tsx:97.

**Code differs**

- app/src/app/camera.tsx:125: advance emits success even after Skip; the contract reserves success for an actual completed job and sale recognition.
- app/src/app/camera.tsx:130: the shutter does not latch on successful native capture; its counter changes before takePictureAsync resolves, and failed stills have no visible Retry.
- app/src/app/camera.tsx:132: native capture errors only log; still count advances before capture acknowledgment, with no retained Retry.
- app/src/app/camera.tsx:158: library ignores chosen assets and mode and replaces /sell; the contract imports into the current task.
- app/src/app/camera.tsx:245: Skip remains active-looking while its handler returns outside typical.
- app/src/ui/parts/camera.tsx:356: filled facts are static, whereas fact openers here permit corrections.
- Shared feedback differs for cam-close (app/src/app/camera.tsx:190); cam-close (app/src/app/camera.tsx:208); cam-library (app/src/app/camera.tsx:243); cam-skip (app/src/app/camera.tsx:245); fact-{f.key}-input (app/src/app/camera.tsx:222); fact-{f.key}-input (app/src/app/camera.tsx:224); fact-{f.key} (app/src/app/camera.tsx:222); fact-{f.key} (app/src/app/camera.tsx:224); unsure-{i + 1} (app/src/app/camera.tsx:272). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for cam-shutter (app/src/app/camera.tsx:244); unsure-{i + 1} (app/src/app/camera.tsx:272). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. Affected call sites: app/src/app/camera.tsx:190, app/src/app/camera.tsx:192, app/src/app/camera.tsx:193, app/src/app/camera.tsx:208, app/src/app/camera.tsx:222, app/src/app/camera.tsx:224, app/src/app/camera.tsx:234, app/src/app/camera.tsx:235, app/src/app/camera.tsx:237, app/src/app/camera.tsx:243, app/src/app/camera.tsx:244, app/src/app/camera.tsx:245, app/src/app/camera.tsx:261, app/src/app/camera.tsx:262, app/src/app/camera.tsx:272, app/src/app/camera.tsx:275, app/src/app/camera.tsx:276, app/src/app/camera.tsx:283, app/src/app/camera.tsx:284.

**Code differs**

- app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:26: authenticated state is local, without protected-route removal.
- app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:49: Back changes a local setup step but edge swipe does not share that step logic.
- app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:98: page contract steps for import review, sales email and notification permission are absent; this spec covers existing touch surfaces and does not invent their IDs.
- app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:31: authentication is a demo timer, not an acknowledged provider request.
- app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:65: incomplete code is enabled; the contract disables until six digits exist.
- Shared feedback differs for onboarding-spot-input (app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:58); onboarding-spot (app/src/app/onboarding.tsx:58); signin-email-address-input (app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:56); signin-email-address (app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:56); signin-email-code-input (app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:69); signin-email-code (app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:69). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for signin-email-send (app/src/you/sign-in.tsx:52). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. - app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:16: Ship inherits a push, instead of the task sheet contract.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:150: label and carrier flows do not implement the complete native print and acknowledged failure lifecycle.

See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for cancel-confirm (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:279); cancel-reason-{r.id} (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:273); payout-speed-free (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:238); payout-speed-today (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:239); self-save (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:268); self-tracking-with (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:259); self-tracking-without (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:260); ship-done (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:148); ship-print (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:150); ship-scope-all (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:181); ship-scope-one (app/src/app/item/[id]/ship.tsx:180). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. **Code differs**

- app/src/app/item/[id]/_layout.tsx:16: Pickup inherits push instead of formSheet.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:106: buyer messages use a local timer, without sending acknowledgments or failed Retry.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:111: Apple Calendar uses a data URL instead of a native calendar editor.
- app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:237: empty-address approval is enabled and silently returns.
- Shared feedback differs for meet-draft-input (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:311); pickup-address-input (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:236); pickup-address (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:236); place-{s.id} (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:298). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for cancel-pickup-confirm (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:250); late-by-{m} (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:243); late-send (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:245); meet-approve (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:124); meet-day-{d.key} (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:285); meet-draft-send (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:311); pickup-send-address (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:237); place-{s.id} (app/src/app/item/[id]/pickup.tsx:298). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. **Code differs**

- app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:111: visitor sign-in pushes onboarding instead of a resumable modal over the listing.
- app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:59: offer submission is a local timer.
- app/src/ui/parts/gallery.tsx:20: photo changes log during scroll as well as settling; contract logs settled page only.
- Shared feedback differs for listing-offer-amount-input (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:100); listing-offer-amount (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:100); listing-pick-amount-{o.id} (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:124); listing-pick-other-input (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:124); listing-pick-other (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:124); listing-product (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:122). See app/src/ui/press.tsx:65.
- Commit haptics are absent for listing-pick-amount-{o.id} (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:124); listing-pick-send (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:124); listing-send (app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:71). No application haptic is wired in these handlers.
- The operation IDs, complete disabled/loading/failed/done cycle, masking and acknowledged inverses in these rows are required behavior. Current local handlers or optional callbacks do not establish that contract. Affected call sites: app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:100, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:110, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:111, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:112, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:122, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:124, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:130, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:133, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:136, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:43, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:70, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:71, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:72, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:76, app/src/app/listing/[id].tsx:79.
